description: This is a Java source file defining the class MockBasicCluster, which extends MockCluster. It models a mock device cluster with attributes such as manufacturer, model, hardware version, and firmware version, and includes methods for handling attribute data and commands.

classes.name: MockBasicCluster
classes.description: A mock implementation of a device cluster that stores product-specific attributes and handles basic commands.

methods.name: getAttributeData
methods.description: Returns byte array of attribute data based on attribute info.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Processes received commands by their ID.

methods.name: setDefaulted
methods.description: Sets the defaulted state of the cluster.

methods.name: isDefaulted
methods.description: Returns whether the cluster is in a defaulted state.
